reviews.comment: Professor Berkowitz is super understanding and puts together great lectures with room for discussion on really interesting topics. The assignments are all straightforward and there are extra credit opportunities that make it easy to get an A as long as you keep up with your work. No exams, and the big graded assignments are engaging!
Always responded within 24 hrs, made sure we understood the material. (If you really want a good grade in her class, go to office hours and sit in the front. I did both and ended up with a 102.)
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I loved my time in her SOCI 205 course. She is very kind and understanding. Her lectures are interesting and she presents them in a great way. Attendance is required and participation through in class assignments, which is a good thing. I 10/10 recommend you take this course with her, she's amazing
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Berkowitz is great! Her lectures are easy to understand and entertaining. There aren't a ton of assignments, but she gives extra credit, so it's okay if you get a bad grade. I would definitely recommend taking Sociology 205 with her.

Professor Berkowitz is a real gem. She gives no tests/exams and no papers, as she hates grading them. The only major grades in the class are video responses you have to do about a documentary. Homework takes maybe thirty minutes a week, if that. Just show up and take notes because they help with the documentary and you'll get an easy A.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She is an amazing professor. Her lectures are very interesting and she grades attendance by asking question based off the lecture. There are NO tests, just worksheets based off a documentary. Many opportunities for extra credit. She is very accessible outside of class for office hours.

Amazing prof! Lectures are very easy to understand. She takes attendance by asking questions about the lecture, so pay attention. She offers a lot of extra credit, and no tests. Just in depth worksheets. She also gives a lot of feedback on work if you ask.
